title: Discord webhook notifier
description: Check the temperature trough a web api and return wether it is in a minimal threshold or not

validationFields.title: the title that will be displayed at the top
validationFields.labelText: the text the label will have in front of it
validationFields.wantedType: string/int/bool -> note that if left empty no check is done , and you will need to rely on the assert data
